items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The album you did for Milestone with Marshall Brown, Dick Katz, Eddie Gomez, and Jack DeJohnette: Peace Meal.

ctx.x: [Laughing] I wish I could help you with it. It’s like I wasn’t there or something. I can’t remember all these dates and details.
It’s a lot of music. It’s a hell of a lot of music. The album you did for Milestone with Marshall Brown, Dick Katz, Eddie Gomez, and Jack DeJohnette: Peace Meal.
